title: Registration for the Bring-your-own-problem Hackathon is Open (23, 24, 26, November)
body:
# Registration for the HPC-DAT Bring-your-own-problem Hackathon is open!

### Come join us 23, 24, and 26 November 2026 at the Netherlands eScience Center for the HPC-DAT bring-your-own-problem hackathon

**Registration for all days or (parts) of individual days is possible [here](https://event.surf.nl/hackathon-high-performance-computing-with-python-and-rs-dat/registration/#/participants)**

- **Where:** Netherlands eScience Center, Science Park 402, 1098 XG Amsterdam (MATRIX III)
- **When:** 23, 24, & 26 November 2026

Want to 
- **Scale up with Dask:** Get support with scaling your analysis or workflow.
- **Run your analysis on HPC:** Explore how to use the RS-DAT framework.
- **Discuss Python workflows:** Exchange ideas about interactive Python and Python-based workflows on HPC?

Join us on **all or any** of the days.
